items.title: There's no time to improvise when an engine fails over high terrain. The aircraft can't hold its cruising level, and the crew needs to know right now which way to turn and how low
items.summary: There's no time to improvise when an engine fails over high terrain. The aircraft can't hold its cruising level, and the crew needs to know right now which way to turn and how low they can safely go. Airlines plan for this. Flight Ops Engineers prepare escape routes for terrain-critical segments, per aircraft type and per failure: a depressurisation route to get down quickly, a drift-down route to keep terrain clearance after an engine failure.
